question_text: The Congress is considering the creation of an autonomous region in the Cordilleras. Under Article X of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is a requirement for the establishment of autonomous regions in Muslim Mindanao and the Cordilleras?

options.text: The autonomous region must be approved by a majority vote of the residents in a plebiscite held in the proposed area.
The autonomous region can be created by a simple act of Congress without any plebiscite.
The autonomous region requires the approval of at least two-thirds of all members of Congress.
The autonomous region must be ratified by a majority vote in a national referendum.
